words.definition: at a later time; after something else has happened
words.example: We'll have dinner and go over the contract afterward.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們會先吃晚餐，之後再討論合約。

words.definition: a statement expressing regret for a mistake
words.example: The company sent a formal apology for the shipping error.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司針對出貨錯誤發出了正式道歉。

words.definition: to put the parts of something together, or to gather in a group
words.example: Workers assemble the furniture before it's shipped to stores.
words.exampleTranslation: 工人在家具送到店面前先組裝好。

words.definition: operating without direct human control
words.example: The building has automatic doors at the main entrance.
words.exampleTranslation: 這棟大樓的正門有自動門。

words.definition: a room where a company's board of directors meets
words.example: The final decision was made in the boardroom this morning.
words.exampleTranslation: 最終決定是今天早上在董事會議室做出的。

words.definition: a person who builds and repairs wooden structures
words.example: A carpenter was hired to build custom shelving for the office.
words.exampleTranslation: 有人請了木匠來為辦公室打造訂製層架。

words.definition: a person or company that provides food for events
words.example: We booked a caterer for the company's anniversary dinner.
words.exampleTranslation: 我們為公司週年晚宴預訂了外燴業者。

words.definition: to arrange things into groups based on shared characteristics
words.example: Please classify these expenses by department before submitting the report.
words.exampleTranslation: 提交報告前請先依部門將這些費用分類。

words.definition: a meeting to discuss something or get expert advice
words.example: The lawyer offers a free consultation for new clients.
words.exampleTranslation: 這位律師提供新客戶免費諮詢。

words.definition: able to withstand wear and last a long time
words.example: The packaging is designed to be durable during long shipments.
words.exampleTranslation: 這款包裝設計成能在長途運送中保持耐用。

words.definition: a covering for the hand, usually with separate parts for each finger
words.example: Warehouse staff must wear gloves when handling the equipment.
words.exampleTranslation: 倉庫人員在操作設備時必須戴手套。

words.definition: the physical components of a computer system, or tools and equipment
words.example: The IT department will replace outdated hardware next month.
words.exampleTranslation: 資訊部門下個月會更換過時的硬體設備。

words.definition: a failure to work correctly
words.example: A system malfunction caused the website to go offline briefly.
words.exampleTranslation: 一次系統故障導致網站短暫離線。

words.definition: no longer modern or in use; old-fashioned
words.example: The manual contains outdated information about the return policy.
words.exampleTranslation: 這本手冊裡有關於退貨政策的過時資訊。

words.definition: the ability to wait calmly without becoming annoyed
words.example: We appreciate your patience while we resolve this issue.
words.exampleTranslation: 感謝您在我們解決這個問題時的耐心等候。

words.definition: a card used for sending a short message without an envelope
words.example: The hotel gift shop sells postcards of the local area.
words.exampleTranslation: 飯店禮品店有販售當地風景的明信片。

words.definition: likely to happen or become something in the future; potential
words.example: The recruiter is meeting with several prospective candidates this week.
words.exampleTranslation: 招募人員這週要跟幾位潛在候選人面談。

words.definition: a change or correction made to a document or plan
words.example: Please review the latest revision of the contract before signing.
words.exampleTranslation: 簽署前請先檢閱合約的最新修訂版本。

words.definition: in a way that is exact and rigorously enforced
words.example: Smoking is strictly prohibited inside the building.
words.exampleTranslation: 建築物內嚴格禁止吸菸。

words.definition: a red fruit commonly used as a vegetable in cooking
words.example: The cafeteria menu features a fresh tomato soup today.
words.exampleTranslation: 員工餐廳今天的菜單有新鮮番茄湯。
